_about: Picks replayed for the class demo video. Taken from the live Bet Logs (NFL #6, NFL #3, NBA #6, PGA #5) with the research saved at the time. replay.py reprices each one from the relay's history snapshot; the agent logs them to the Demo Run Bet Logs in Notion.

picks.pick: NO -7.5 vs CLE (Kalshi: YES on 'NO wins by over 7.5')
picks.research: Model has NO by 4.2 against a market of 3 and prices an 8+ point NO win at 40% versus a 32c cost (+8.3c). Research points the same way: Browns QB Deshaun Watson entered the concussion protocol Tuesday and Shedeur Sanders would likely make his first start of the season (7 TD, 10 INT, 56.6% as a rookie in 2025), and the model only sees team efficiency, not the QB downgrade. Model disagrees with Pinnacle by only 1.2 points. Main risks: the market may already price Sanders (nflverse lists him as the CLE QB), and Watson could still clear protocol; re-check Friday's report and void if Watson is cleared and the line moves.

picks.pick: CIN -9.5 vs ATL in Madrid (Kalshi: YES on 'CIN wins by over 9.5')
picks.research: Model makes CIN a 5.4-point favorite at a neutral site against a market of 3 (books, Pinnacle and Kalshi all at 3), and prices a 10+ point CIN win at 38% versus a 28c all-in cost (+10.1c edge). Every rung on the CIN ladder from 3.5 to 20.5 shows a 4-10c edge, so the signal is the margin view, not one stale rung. Research supports it: CIN is 5-2 on a three-game win streak with Burrow at 20 TD / 6 INT, while ATL is 3-5 and was shut out by Tampa last week. Main risk: a long rung loses most of the time even when the read is right; the safer book version (CIN -3 -112 DraftKings) was only a 4c edge.
sources: Kalshi relay snapshot 2026-11-05T19:19Z; Odds API snapshot 2026-11-05T19:19Z (nfl-kalshi/data)

picks.research: Model has HOU -18.6 vs DraftKings -15.5 and Pinnacle/consensus -16 (2.6 pts off Pinnacle, inside the market check). Best rung is Kalshi HOU by 19+ at 42.71c all-in (+134), model 50%, +7.5c; best book price was DK -15.5 -114 (model 58.5%, smaller edge). picks.research: Model gives ADC a 42.9% chance to miss the cut vs an all-in NO cost of 35.6c (Kalshi YES mid 67c), a +7.35c edge on 58.5 effective rounds. His ball-striking is weak for a fairways-and-greens course: 155th SG Off-the-Tee, 112th SG Approach, 128th in GIR; he leans on putting (17th) and short game (18th). The counterpoint is form: T17, T34, T25 in his last three starts, so the market may be right to rate him higher. Low confidence, 0.5u.
